content: Go case mapping: strings.ToUpper/ToLower do SIMPLE case mapping per rune; unicode.SpecialCase exists for language-specific mappings (Turkish/Azeri) but must be invoked explicitly. Consequences for layout conversion: byte-indexing/slicing UTF-8 strings corrupts runes (operate on []rune); per-rune simple mapping is sufficient for ASCII<->Cyrillic EN<->RU (no special casing in either), but Greek final sigma, German sharp s, dotted-I locales and ligatures break naive per-rune mapping if tables generalize (spec Q5 non-Cyrillic layouts). Decomposed forms (NFD, combining marks like U+0306) can appear via dead keys/compose - buffer counting must count grapheme clusters or runes consistently, not bytes.
